start: The colony wakes for the first time. {count} souls gather around the Wheel. Everything now depends on Squeektoshi.
nightfall: Night {night}. Squeektoshi steps off the Wheel after {ran}. The furnace dims to embers.
Night {night}. The Wheel slows, then stops. Lanterns go out one by one.
Night {night}. Squeektoshi curls up to sleep. The colony whispers so as not to wake him.
wake: Squeektoshi is back on the Wheel after {slept} of sleep. Smoke rises from the chimneys.
The Wheel creaks, then spins. After {slept} of darkness, the furnace roars again.
Morning comes when the Wheel turns. Today it came after {slept}.
wake_frozen: The colony thaws slowly. Frost covers {pct}% of the streets, and the first workers chip ice off the doors.
Squeektoshi runs into a frozen town. {pct}% of it lies under ice, but the heat is coming back.
dream: The colony dreams. In the dream, the Wheel never stops and the snow is warm.
A child tells the story of the Great Hamster who carried the sun in his cheeks.
In their sleep, the builders draw a tower nobody has built yet.
Someone dreams of a summer. Nobody alive remembers one.
The old ones dream of the first night, when the Wheel turned for the first time.
A dream spreads through the bunkhouses: somewhere beyond the storm, another Wheel is turning.
The night watch swears the Wheel turned once, all by itself, then stopped.
freeze: The last embers die. The colony enters hibernation and waits for the Wheel.
The heat cellar is empty. Doors close, families huddle together. The town will sleep until Squeektoshi returns.
frost: Frost creeps across the town: {pct}% of the streets are under ice.
The cold deepens. Ice now holds {pct}% of the colony.
unfreeze: The furnace catches again. The hibernation is over.
Heat returns to the pipes. The colony opens its doors.
build_start: The builders mark out the ground for {building}.
arrivals: Squeek block {block}. Out of the storm, drawn by the glow of the Wheel: {names}.
Squeek block {block}. A sled arrives: {names}. The colony makes room.
camp: Not enough beds. {count} newcomers sleep around the furnace, waiting for new shelter.
housed: {count} newcomers finally move into real beds.
sprint: Squeektoshi ran for {minutes}. The furnace held a steady heat.
A run of {minutes}. The reserve climbed and the cold pulled back.
The Wheel turned for {minutes}. The colony felt it in the pipes.
record_sleep: New record: the longest sleep, {slept}. The colony held on.
weather_clear: The sky clears. For a while, the cold loosens its grip.
Clear sky over the crater. Stars, and a little less cold.
weather_wind: The wind rises and howls through the streets. The furnace has to work harder.
A biting wind sweeps down from the crater walls.
weather_snow: Snow falls again, soft and endless.
Heavy flakes drift down on the rooftops.
weather_blizzard: A blizzard hits the crater. Nobody goes outside; everything depends on the Wheel.
Whiteout. The storm swallows the town and the cold doubles its bite.
weather_blizzard_end: The blizzard passes. The colony digs itself out.
The storm is over. The streets are buried, but the Wheel still turns.
infra_tracks_s1: Footprints in the snow. The first paths from the furnace are now worn into the ground.
The inner lanes are taking shape — packed snow where everyone walks.
infra_supply_12: The first supply crates have been emptied and broken down for firewood.
Two crates from the sled are gone. Their planks went to the workshop.
infra_tracks_s2: The paths now reach halfway across the crater. Workers move faster.
The colony's footprints form clear lanes all the way to the mid-ring.
infra_village: Stone bridges cross the ring, and sign posts mark the forks. The camp begins to look like a real village.
Bridges and waymarkers go up. The colony is settling in.
infra_path_0: The first road leaves the Wheel and cuts straight through the snow.
A packed lane now runs from the generator toward the first tents.
infra_path_1: A second road is trodden out. Crates travel faster than they used to.
Another lane opens across the crater floor, marked by lantern posts.
infra_path_2: The third road is packed hard. Workers stop wading through drifts.
A new spoke reaches out from the Wheel. The camp is taking shape.
infra_path_3: The fourth road is open. Sleds glide where boots once sank.
Another lane is cleared and the frost no longer swallows it overnight.
infra_path_4: The fifth road reaches the edge of the settled ground.
A long lane stretches toward the crater wall. Someone hangs a lamp at its end.
infra_path_5: The sixth road is finished. The colony begins to look like a wheel itself.
A road to the far side is laid. Nothing in the camp is out of reach now.
infra_path_6: The seventh and last spoke is laid. Every road now meets at the Wheel.
The final lane joins the rest. The whole colony turns around one center.
infra_supply_34: Two more supply crates emptied. The colony has consumed what it brought.
Half the original stores are gone. Everything from here is earned by the Wheel.
infra_tracks_s3: Footpaths now run the full length of every lane to the outer buildings.
The last stretch of frozen track is beaten flat. Every building is connected.
infra_supply_5: The last supply crate is empty. Everything the colony owns, it built.
The final sled crate has been used. The colony stands on its own now.
infra_ring_n1: The northern arc of the ring road is laid. The great circle has begun.
First quarter of the ring road complete. The colony is starting to loop itself.
infra_lamp_1: A lamp post stands at the ring. The first light outside the furnace.
One lamp by the ring road. Small, but it pushes back the dark.
infra_ring_n2: The eastern arc of the ring road is finished. Half the circle is there.
Two arcs of the ring. The eastern reach is paved and lit.
infra_lamp_2: A second lamp post rises. The ring grows brighter.
Another lamp joins the ring. Two warm circles in the dark.
infra_lamp_3: Three lamp posts now. Walking the ring at night is no longer a gamble.
The third lamp is up. The ring road glows.
infra_ring_n3: Three-quarters of the ring road are complete. The southern arc closes in.
The southern arc is paved. One more stretch and the circle closes.
infra_lamp_4: Four lamps mark the ring. The colony can be seen from the crater walls.
A fourth light on the ring. From above, the colony looks alive.
infra_lamp_5: Five lamp posts circle the ring. Squeektoshi's glow reaches the outer edge.
Five lights on the ring. The colony shines in every direction.
infra_ring_n4: The ring road is complete. The colony is a circle now, lit and paved.
The last arc of the ring locks in place. The great loop is done.
infra_lamp_6: Six lamps — the ring is almost fully lit.
The sixth lamp is raised. The ring burns bright at every compass point.
infra_lamp_7: Seven lamps line the ring. The crater floor glows like an ember.
The seventh lamp joins the ring. The colony blazes against the dark.
infra_lamp_8: All eight lamps are standing. The ring road is fully lit, all thanks to Squeektoshi.
Eight lights on the ring. The colony has made itself a crown of fire.
infra_ring_n5: Work begins on an outer ring beyond the first. The colony starts to claim more of the crater.
A second ring road takes shape at the edge of the colony. This one will take longer.
infra_lamp_9: A ninth lamp post rises along the outer ring. The dark gets a little smaller.
Lamp nine stands. The outer ring starts to glow.
infra_lamp_10: Ten lamps now. The outer ring is half-lit.
The tenth lamp is planted. Crews work by lamplight past midnight.
infra_paths_s4: Wide roads reach the outer buildings. Supply sleds can now run without stopping.
The outer road grid is finished. Every corner of the colony is connected.
infra_ring_n6: The second ring closes. Two circles of road now wrap the colony.
The outer ring is complete. Seen from the crater rim, the colony is a double crown of light.
infra_lamp_11: The eleventh lamp is raised. The outer ring blazes to match the inner.
Eleven lamps. Nobody hides in the dark anymore.
infra_lamp_12: Twelve lamps circle the colony. The crater walls reflect the glow.
The twelfth lamp is up. The colony has lit every lane.
infra_paths_s5: The last roads are graded and packed. Every part of the colony is now reachable at a run.
Final roads complete. The colony moves as one — fast, warm, connected.
build_done_watchtower: The Watchtower stands. From up there, the scouts can see the storm coming before anyone else.
The Watchtower is finished. Its lamp burns all night, a signal to those still out in the cold.
build_done_clinic: The Clinic is open. The healers move in with their instruments and their quiet confidence.
The Clinic stands beside the infirmary. Frost retreats a little faster now.
build_done_grand_hall: The Grand Hall is finished. For the first time, the whole colony can gather under one roof.
The Grand Hall opens its doors. Tonight, everyone is warm and no one eats alone.
build_done_mechanists: The Mechanists Guild is complete. The builders move faster now — every tool sharpened, every joint fitted.
The Guild opens its forge bay. The sound of hammers on iron fills the crater.
build_done_thermal_heart: The Thermal Heart is lit. Deep beneath the colony, the heat now flows without ceasing.
The Thermal Heart pulses. Every wall is warmer, every pipe full. The colony has found its second furnace.
